topic: Modals of Obligation - Lack of Obligation (B1)

exercises.question: You _____ wear a tie to the office, but it is highly recommended for important client meetings.
exercises.explanation: 'Don't have to' shows a lack of obligation (it's optional).

exercises.category: Modals of Obligation - Lack of Obligation (B1)
exercises.question: You ________ bring any food; dinner will be provided.
exercises.explanation: 'Don't have to' means there is no obligation. 'Mustn't' means it is prohibited.
